cohort: Twenty-seven women with a history of elective cervical cerclage failure in a previous pregnancy who underwent elective transvaginal cervicoisthmic cerclage in their current pregnancy between 2015 and 2023.
finding: Elective TVCIC resulted in 96.3% of gestations carrying beyond 32 weeks and 96.3% fetal survival to discharge in women with previous cervical cerclage failure.
